certified_invariants: Portfolio Manager output is advisory capacity only: it does not create OrderIntent, import OMS/broker/engine execution modules, choose side/order type or submit/cancel/replace orders.

A permanent CI authority gate rejects future OMS/broker/engine imports, execution-capable domain symbols and execution-like calls in portfolio_manager.py; tests prove the gate catches representative violations.
The complete strategy candidate universe must exactly match the dependence universe and each strategy@version key is bound to its own Health entity identity.
Base diversification budgets and base allocation robustness are recomputed from source evidence and fingerprint-bound into the sizing decision.
Health controls can only shrink allocation; post-Health budgets, diversification and robustness are recomputed before venue sizing.
Quotes must be finite, tick-aligned, non-future and fresh under explicit policy.
Authoritative Instrument Master rules must be tradable, fresh and identity-matched; unknown/stale/halted metadata fails closed.
Quantity is always rounded down to the authoritative quantity_step and capped downward by venue maximums.
Venue minimums never cause upsizing; below-minimum candidates are zeroed, after which diversification and robustness are recomputed and can fail the whole sizing decision.
Final actual notionals/weights are revalidated against strategy/cluster/portfolio budgets and allocation robustness after Health and venue rounding/caps.
The decision fingerprint binds base budget, base robustness, Health-adjusted budget/robustness, final budget/robustness, candidate/rules evidence and final allocation capacity.
Any future execution path remains required to pass the Capital Safety Kernel and OMS independently; Portfolio Manager has no capital authority.
explicit_non_claims: This is not R4 track certification.
A sizing decision is not an order approval or broker instruction.
This does not grant external PAPER or LIVE authority.
